business: Diversified conglomerate operating digital services (Jio), omnichannel retail, branded consumer products, and energy/chemicals. Serves 524M+ digital customers, 387M retail customers, and consumers across 40+ countries through connectivity, retail, branded products, and energy solutions.

segments.name: Digital Services (Jio)
segments.comment: 524M+ subscribers, 268M+ 5G users, 17.8% EBITDA growth, 241 Exabytes traffic

segments.name: Oil to Chemicals
segments.comment: EBITDA +10.1%, optimized feedstock sourcing and higher operating rates

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.comment: EBITDA -10.1% due to KG D6 natural decline and softer gas prices

segments.name: Consumer Products (RCPL)
segments.comment: ₹22,000cr revenue, 5,000+ distributors, expansion via M&A in staples/beverages

segments.name: Media & Entertainment
segments.comment: EBITDA +218.7%, record viewership, industry-leading engagement metrics

revenue_mix: India-dominant: retail and digital services concentrated domestically. O2C and oil/gas have international footprint. Consumer products expanding to 40+ countries including Australia, UK, Europe via acquisitions.
strategy: Build sovereign AI infrastructure with ₹10 lakh crore investment for multi-GW data centres
Scale hyperlocal commerce through integrated omnichannel retail ecosystem
Accelerate RCPL through organic expansion, strategic M&A, and global brand building
Maximize O2C returns via operational excellence and optimized feedstock sourcing
Leverage diversified portfolio to navigate macroeconomic volatility
outlook: India's consumption environment structurally attractive with favorable demographics and improving incomes. Digital economy growing to $1T by 2030. Organized retail penetration rising. RCPL revenues expected multifold growth by 2030.
capex_plans: FY2026: ₹1,44,271 crore directed to O2C, New Energy, Digital Services, and Retail. Additional ₹10 lakh crore committed for AI-ready data centre development.
risks: Trade uncertainties, regional conflicts, geopolitical disruptions impacting supply chains and investment sentiment
Macroeconomic volatility affecting consumer discretionary spending and energy market cyclicality
Limited quality real estate availability for retail store expansion in key markets
Input cost inflation and talent acquisition/retention challenges amid aggressive hyperlocal scaling
flags: Material Related Party Transactions of Company and Subsidiaries approved at AGM (Items 6-7). Directors Akash M. Ambani and Anant M. Ambani retiring by rotation. S&P upgraded rating from BBB+ to A- in December 2025.
